CASE 24-017
Holding the line on the Serra do Suído pine die-back.

A four-year program closed in November with 612 ha of pinaster replaced by mixed native canopy. Mortality dropped from 41% to 7% after the second growing season.

CASE 24-031
Ria Formosa estuary returns 1,872 ha to tidal exchange.
